Mr. Stephen Kodumbe
(Company Secretary)
Mr. Kodumbe joined DTB Kenya in 2008 as the Manager, Legal Services and was appointed Company Secretary in
August 2009. He holds a Bachelor of Laws (LL. B) Degree and a Masters in Business Administration Degree from the
University of Nairobi together with a Diploma from the Kenya School of Law. Besides being an Advocate of the High
Court of Kenya and a registered Certified Public Secretary, Mr. Kodumbe is a member of the Law Society of Kenya,
the Institute of Certified Public Secretaries of Kenya and the Institute of Directors (Kenya). He is also currently
pursuing qualification as a Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS). Mr. Kodumbe is aged 43 years.
